functions.description: Parse base syslog structure: timestamp, host, event id, severity, and quoted message body
Extract user and source IP (IPv4 or bracketed IPv6) from message text across auth/vpn/admin/hostchecker events
Extract VPN/session identifier when present in message
Strip enclosing brackets from IPv6 source addresses
Classify action outcome from message text and normalize severity casing

add.name: action
add.value: message && message.match(/successful/i) ? 'success' : message && message.match(/failed|failure|invalid|locked/i) ? 'failure' : message && message.match(/established/i) ? 'session_start' : message && message.match(/ended/i) ? 'session_end' : message && message.match(/modified/i) ? 'config_change' : message && message.match(/logged into/i) ? 'login' : 'info'

functions.description: Derive event category from event id prefix

add.name: event_category
add.value: event_id && event_id.startsWith('AUT') ? 'authentication' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('NET') ? 'network' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('ADM') ? 'admin' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('HCK') ? 'host_checker' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('SYS') ? 'system' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('CRT') ? 'certificate' : 'other'
